title: echo and amethyst ores
description: This mod adds ore blocks for echo and amethyst ore plus a new banner pattern and disk
body:
a mod that adds ore blocks for amethyst and echo shards, a banner pattern, and a music disc

Items:

- vortex music disc
- shriek banner pattern

blocks:

- stone and deepslate echo shard ore
- stone and deepslate amethyst ore
